name: joblog-long-command-starves-output
description: A job log pane in a narrow workspace column keeps a real output viewport under a long command. The command block is bounded and scrolls inside itself, the virtual list keeps at least half of the log column and a nonzero height, and a short command stays fully visible rather than clipped. The fixtures reproduce JobLog.tsx's PaneScaffold > transcript column > command block > .joblog chain with the real component stylesheets; the long command is the 832-character barrier script the background-jobs browser guard renders, recovered from its retained failure DOM.

allowlist..body: transcript.module.css is prefixed to log-*, so resolved.css has no shared .body selector; the raw sheets both define it and the scaffold body uses panescaffold.module.css.
allowlist..header: codeblock.module.css is prefixed to code-*, so resolved.css has no shared .header selector; the raw sheets both define it and the pane header uses panescaffold.module.css.
allowlist..root: virtuallist.module.css is prefixed to list-*, so resolved.css has no shared .root selector; the raw sheets both define it and the command block uses codeblock.module.css.

mutation.declaration: panes/transcript/transcript.module.css: remove .joblogCommand's max-height and its overflow-y/overflow-x pair, leaving flex: 0 0 auto so the command grows to its full wrapped content height
mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-23 at the 402px-wide, 700px-tall pane the guard screenshotted: without the cap the long fixture's list viewport collapses to 0px and its command block is 802px of the 602px log column (the pane body then scrolls by 204px); restoring the cap returns the list to 334px and bounds the command to 240px, while the short fixture stays at a 468px list and an unscrolled 106px command either way. Dropping min-height:0 leaves the case green: overflow-y:auto already makes the block a scroll container, whose automatic minimum size is zero, so max-height plus the overflow pair is the whole fix.
